afk.py.summary: Find unused imports in Python files, directories and archives and optionally remove them.
details: Scans each source file for imports that are never referenced, honouring ``__all__``, ``# noqa`` markers and ``try`` blocks. Archives (``.zip``, ``.tar``, ``.tar.gz``/``bz2``/``xz``, wheel and zstandard) are unpacked in memory, so the archive itself is only rewritten when a fix is requested.

brer.py.summary: Compress or decompress files and directories with Brotli.
details: Files are turned into ``.br`` streams and directories into ``.tar.br`` archives, in worker pools. Chunked mode is used automatically for large inputs and the original is kept when compression does not shrink it (unless ``--force``).
